description: This file contains the implementation of an in-memory version of the IMembershipTable interface for testing purposes within the Orleans distributed application framework. It manages membership entries and provides methods to insert, update, delete, and read membership data, along with version control and call tracking features.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: A mock in-memory implementation of IMembershipTable used for unit testing Orleans membership functionality. It tracks calls, manages membership entries, and handles versioning.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Default constructor for initializing the in-memory membership table.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table with an initial version and set of membership entries.

methods.name: Calls
methods.description: Property that returns a list of method calls made on this table for inspection.

methods.name: ClearCalls
methods.description: Clears the internal call tracking list.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the membership entries and increments the version.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries marked as dead that are older than the specified date.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Records a delete operation for a specific cluster ID.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Records the initialization of the membership table with a flag indicating whether to try init.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Attempts to add a new membership entry with version control, succeeding only if the address does not already exist.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Returns all membership entries and current version.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Returns data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if the etag matches, with version validation.

methods.name: ValidateVersion
methods.description: Ensures version etag matches and that the version number is increasing.
